standalone_raw_recount.method: Raw CSV only; standard library only; no imports from dashboard/build state code or processed database.

rules.scope: T20 second innings only; first two innings only; 120 scheduled balls.
rules.batting_pressure: 1-30 legal balls remaining; at least 3 wickets down before the ball; required rate >= 15; positive runs needed.
rules.bowling_pressure: 1-30 legal balls remaining; 2 or fewer wickets down before the ball; required rate >= 9; current rate >= 11; positive runs needed.
rules.legality: none/byes/legbyes legal; wide/Overstep illegal; other/Penalty/blank/unrecognized unknown; unknown row and all later states excluded.
rules.target: matches.revised_target when nonblank; otherwise first innings runs plus one per wide, Overstep, bye, and leg-bye, then plus one.
rules.imputation: One team run per wide, Overstep, bye, and leg-bye row; raw runs column is retained for batter runs.
rules.wickets: Pre-delivery count of is_wicket rows, excluding retire-outs, retired hurt, and obstruction labels.
rules.batter_dismissals: is_wicket rows assigned to dismissed_player_id; the same exclusions apply.
rules.player_key: Unique source player_id; IDs with unknown/blank names or multiple source names are excluded from player figures.
